lines.t: Hatsune Miku once sold cars in America.

full.credit: Clips: Yami Sweet (2011 Toyota ad); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)

lines.t: In May 2011, Toyota made her the face of the Corolla. They called it the official car of Hatsune Miku.

full.credit: Clips: Yami Sweet (2011 Toyota ad); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)

lines.t: In the first ad, she drives the car herself. Fans pointed out, she's supposed to be 16.

full.credit: Clips: Yami Sweet (2011 Toyota ad); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)

lines.t: Toyota also sponsored her first ever concert in America, in Los Angeles that July.

full.credit: Clips: Yami Sweet (2011 Toyota ad); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)
